scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide view of a city street with pedestrians walking along the sidewalk and buildings lining both sides of the street. The sky is mostly cloudy but bright and sunny,
scene_analysis.buildings: The buildings are tall and modern with large windows and flat roofs. Some have balconies and others have decorative elements like columns and arches.
scene_analysis.materials: The ground is made of concrete with some brick accents.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and trash cans along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.vegetation: There are small trees and bushes planted in planters along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs advertising businesses and directions.
scene_analysis.pedestrian_activity: People are walking in different directions, some alone and some in groups.
scene_analysis.as_resident: Some people are sitting on benches or walking dogs.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: There are some tourists taking photos and admiring the architecture.
scene_analysis.as_student: There are some students studying or working on projects.
